Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to disambiguate the ambiguous title “Voice” and did not follow the Planner’s explicit instruction to target the 2005 South Korean film (e.g., “Voice 2005 South Korean film genre”). Instead, it treated search results for the TV series “Voice” (2017–) as the movie, reporting TV genres (Action/Crime/Mystery). This misclassification led to the incorrect downstream conclusion that “Voice” is not a film, when the task actually refers to the 2005 Korean horror film (Whispering Corridors 4).
